race.comment: SO FORTUNATE (8) is improving with racing and a win looks imminent. Sat on the speed and kept finding with a gritty third over 1506m at Port Macquarie. Terrific chance to break through in a very thin contest. REPEAT OFFENDER (7) third up for this and the blinkers go on after she finished a plugging fourth over 1506m at Port Macquarie. Just under a month between runs on that occasion and strips fitter now. BRAVO SIX (2) lugging bit goes on today and comes back in trip with Williams' claim. Never travelled in the run with a below-par fourth over 1820m at Griffith as the ($2.05 fav).  Has further improvement to come and gets one more chance. FOLLOW THAT DREAM (6) best performance in seven starts when she sat on the speed to run a tidy second over 1720m at this track. Will benefit from Spokes' claim again from the good gate. Stays in the mix.
